minutes_text:
PERMITS AND LICENSES COMMITTEE
  MINUTES
  January 10, 2019

A meeting of the Permits and License Committee was held on Thursday, January 10,
2019, at 2:05 pm in the City Council Community Room A, 1st Floor

Roll Call:  Members Present:  Harjinder Singh, Administration
  Yvonne Horton, City Clerk – 2:06 pm
  Cpt. Reggie Johnson, LACO Fire Department
  Sgt. Luis Jaramillo, Police Department
  Marissa Fewell, Planning & Building Department

  Staff Present:  Peggy L. Velasquez, Finance Department
  Serena Martinez, Finance Department

Also present: Jerry Tucker, Code Enforcement Manager and Carmen Lopez, Senior Code
Enforcement Officer.

Public Comments Regarding Agenda Items
During public comments any person may address the Permits & License Committee,
provided the item is within the subject matter jurisdiction of the Permits & License
Committee.
Chairman Singh asked if there were any persons present who wished to address the
Permits & License Committee on any item on the Agenda.
Chairman Singh reported that there were no public requests to speak.

A motion was moved and seconded to approve the minutes from the meeting held on
December 13, 2018.

Item #1:  A motion was moved and seconded to APPROVE the permit request for
  Mike Hellyar; dba: GC Event Pros to host ALT 98.7 presents iHeartRadio
  ALTer Ego 2019, January 19, 2019 from 3:00 pm – 6:30 pm, subject to
  placement of stage and amplified equipment shall be designed to mitigate
  and minimize the noise level, impacting neighboring residents; maintain
  safe and secure crowd control; maintain site at all times, ensuring site is
  properly cleaned immediately at the end of the event; obtain Special One-
  Day Event Permit from the Department of Alcoholic Beverage and Control;
  Inglewood Police Department staff and Forum Security personnel required;
  security guards must be assigned to the outdoor bar area to check for
  proper identification to prevent underage drinking; applicant, property
  owner, vendor and performers responsible for noise mitigation/abatement
  efforts in compliance with Inglewood Municipal Code, Section 5-30.
  Maximum Residential Noise Levels, Section 5-50. Registration for
  Amplified Sound Equipment and Section 5-51. Regulations for Amplified
  Sound Equipment; applicant must provide name, phone number and email
  of the sound technician responsible for noise mitigation and abatement
  efforts prior to the start of the event to Jerry Tucker, Code Enforcement
  Manager via email at jtucker@cityofinglewood.org and Inglewood Watch
  Commander via email at watchcommander@cityofinglewood.org; one (1)
  Code Enforcement Officer will be staffed for soundcheck from 9:00 am –
 Permits & License Committee  January 10, 2019
Minutes  Page 2 of 2

  10:00 am and return from 3:30 pm – 6:00 pm; Forum is responsible for the
  payment of City staff/IPD personnel; responsible for verifying and insuring
  catering trucks possess Los Angeles County Health Permits at the time of
  this event; catering trucks are subject to unannounced inspection by City
  staff for verification of Los Angeles County Health Department permits;
  applicant, vendors, bartenders are responsible and must adhere to all State
  and local Alcoholic Beverage and Control laws and regulations; applicant,
  vendors, bartenders are subject to unannounced compliance inspection by
  City staff; applicant shall provide and pay associated costs for two (2) Code
  Enforcement Officers for this event; applicant to contact the Code
  Enforcement Division at (310) 412-5590 for questions regarding imposed
  conditions; Ensure safe pedestrian and vehicular circulation on/off site;
  adhere to all applicable IMC regulations, including noise and signage.
  Motion carried unanimously. (Activity No. 00273123)

Item #5:  A motion was moved and seconded to APPROVE the business license
  request for Dylan Keshmir; dba: United Automotive Network, Inc., to
  operate as a used car dealer at 817 N. La Brea Ave., subject to payment
  of annual business license and tax renewals; provide list of all employees
  and include valid government-issued identification; an expired or lapsed
  license for more than six months will negatively impact your license
  renewal; parking of vehicles, vehicle repairs and/or maintenance on city
  streets, sidewalks or alleys is strictly prohibited and violators will be cited
  and towed at owners expense; automobiles displayed for sale are to be
  parked on private property indicated on the business license application;
  adhere to all applicable Inglewood Municipal regulations, including noise
  and signage. Motion carried unanimously. (Renewal Yr. 2019 - Activity
  No. 00249719 and Renewal Yr. 2018 – Activity No. 00227150)
  Present: Dylan Keshmir, President, United Automotive Network, Inc.

Item #5:  Adiam Kasmai; dba: Pure Sky Lounge to operate as a tobacco retailer and
  hookah lounge at 630 N. La Brea Ave., Unit 105, Committee recommended
  item be held-over to give the applicant time to provide the additional
  supplemental documents (1) provide proof of finalized building permit (2)
  submit floor plan and parking lot site plan to the Planning Department. (Activity
  No. 00249495)
  Present: Adiam Kasmai, Owner, Pure Sky Lounge

There being no further business, the meeting was adjourned at 2:23pm.

  Respectfully submitted,
  Peggy L. Velasquez, Recording Secretary
